guards.what: WAIL into a reviving Parafright: PowerCmd has no CanReceivePowers guard
guards.issue: CARRIED FROM power/illusion PER RULE 3, and this unit is a concrete SITE of it. TheObscura.cs:101 applies StrengthPower 3m to `GetTeammatesOf(base.Creature)`, which is `GetCreaturesOnSide(creature.Side)` (CombatState.cs:397-400) and therefore includes the summoned Parafright. C#'s PowerCmd.Apply refuses any target whose `CanReceivePowers` is false (PowerCmd.cs:73-76, and again at :133), and CanReceivePowers reuses Hook.ShouldAllowHitting, which IllusionPower.cs:95-106 returns FALSE for while the illusion is reviving -- the override's own doc comment (IllusionPower.cs:92-94) says it exists precisely 'so the owner doesn't receive powers while it is reviving'. The sim's PowerCmd.apply (cmds.py:271-331) has no CanReceivePowers/should_allow_hitting guard at all, so a Wail cast on the turn a Parafright is reviving lands +3 Strength that the game refuses. LIVE: `the_obscura` is a ported Hive normal encounter (rooms.py:163), the Parafright is summoned by the machine's guaranteed opening move, WAIL is one of the three branches it then rolls, and killing the Parafright to open the revive window is ordinary play. The verdict and its executed evidence belong to audit/records/power/illusion.json's ShouldAllowHitting entry (and power_cmd G6, which that entry upgrades); recorded here so the monster tier does not disagree.
